facts.text: The environment id Isaac-Inhand-Rotate-Sharpa-Wave-v0 is registered with entry point rl_isaaclab.tasks.inhand_rotate.sharpa_wave_env:SharpaWaveInhandRotateEnv and config SharpaWaveEnvCfg
The environment class subclasses DirectRLEnv imported from isaaclab.envs
The task config sets episode_length_s 20.0, action_space 22 and observation_space 192
The control loop decimates 12 physics steps of dt 1/240 s per control step, 0.05 s
The config sets clip_actions to 1.0 and action_scale to 1/24
_pre_physics_step saturates actions to plus or minus cfg.clip_actions, adds cfg.action_scale times the action to prev_targets and saturates targets to the hand joint limits
The environment uses torque control
The hand joint limits are read from the articulation and multiplied by cfg.dof_limits_scale
The config sets dof_limits_scale to 0.9
The grasp cache filename combines cfg.grasp_cache_path, the two scale endpoints and the scale count
The configured grasp_cache_path is cache/sharpa_grasp_linspace
A reset raises RuntimeError('No saved grasping states found') when no grasp cache is loaded
The policy observation is the last three frames of a 64-value history: 22 scaled joint positions, 22 joint targets, 5 contact values and 15 contact positions per frame
The config sets angvel_clip_min to -0.5, angvel_clip_max to 0.5 and rotate_reward_scale to 2.5
The total reward adds the six terms rotate_reward, object_linvel_penalty, pos_diff_penalty, torque_penalty, work_penalty and object_pos_diff, each multiplied by its configured scale
The five remaining reward scales are -0.3, -0.4, -0.1, -0.5 and 0.003
The episode truncates when episode_length_buf reaches max_episode_length - 1 and terminates when the object height leaves the reset band
The reset height band is 0.59906 to 0.63906 m
The configured scene has 16384 environments
Tactile contact observations are enabled and contact positions are disabled by default
The repository tells the user to install IsaacLab from its official guide before this package
SharpaWaveEnvCfg subclasses DirectRLEnvCfg and is decorated with configclass
The hardware deploy environment imports SharpaWaveManager, ControlMode, ControlSource and SharpaWaveConfig from sharpa
The hardware deploy step converts its current targets and calls hand.set_joint_position(command)

determinism.notes: reset(seed) re-seeds the fake's Python random generator, and the kinematic update and reward are deterministic, so one seed and action sequence repeats; the upstream environment draws from torch generators and the saved grasp cache, so the two are not expected to agree

gaps: the action space is published unbounded because the Isaac Lab base outside the clone builds it; the fake clips every action component to the upstream clip_actions 1.0 inside step (sharpa_wave_env_cfg.py:51, sharpa_wave_env.py:178), so no action-value limit is derived
no dynamics: the fake is a kinematic/analytic model with no forces, contacts, friction, actuator, sensor or noise model; joint positions follow a first-order lag and the object's yaw is a proxy

one environment instead of the configured 16384 (sharpa_wave_env_cfg.py:259); the action and observation spaces and returned arrays are unbatched; the policy observation is 192 values, not 16384 x 192, and the fake returns scalar rewards and done flags instead of Torch batches
the fake omits the upstream priv_info (8 values) and proprio_hist (30 x 64 = 1920 values) buffers and returns only the policy observation
the tactile channels of the policy observation are held at zero (5 contact values and 15 contact positions) because the fake has no contact sensors
reset joint positions are placeholder draws, not samples from cache/sharpa_grasp_linspace_*.npy; the upstream reset requires that cache (sharpa_wave_env.py:292-300)

the fake accepts and ignores reset options; the upstream public reset is inherited from DirectRLEnv outside this clone, while the in-clone _reset_idx hook selects environment ids; no equivalence of public reset options is established
the joint limits and PD gains are placeholder internal constants; upstream reads them from the USD articulation and randomizes the gains (sharpa_wave_env.py:86-95, sharpa_wave_env_cfg.py:296-300)
the reward uses the upstream formula and scales but its terms come from the proxy state, so its values are not comparable with upstream training runs
the fake was never compared with the upstream environment: Isaac Lab, Isaac Sim and a GPU are required (README.md:9-13 and sharpa_wave_env_cfg.py:259), and this package never imports the clone

no live factory is declared: gym.make alone does not supply the mandatory cfg argument (sharpa_wave_env.py:31); upstream train.py:31-32 launches AppLauncher and :89 supplies cfg; live use also needs a batched Torch adapter, application lifecycle isolation and the grasp cache
upstream construction can exit on an invalid scale/environment count (sharpa_wave_env.py:105-108) and the gravity curriculum prints to stdout (:265); neither behavior runs in the fake
the fake models its own episode counter against max_episode_length - 1; external Isaac Lab automatic resets and lifecycle are not reproduced
SharpaWaveInhandRotateDeployEnv is a separate real-hand environment using the external sharpa SDK and hand.set_joint_position (sharpa_wave_deploy_env.py:18-23,227-228); it is outside this R0 package
snapshot and restore are not offered: the environment exposes no get_state/set_state
no wall-clock pacing: lockstep, realtime_factor 0, only commands advance the fake's time

safe_state.description: the lockstep fake is frozen once in-flight work settles; the runtime latch refuses step, reset and seed until mhs.safety.reset clears it, and the last observation stays readable; no native Isaac stop or stop of SharpaWaveInhandRotateDeployEnv hardware is claimed
